title: Perrin Beitel Road

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located at 11714 Perrin Beitel Road, just south of Thousand Oaks Drive and north of Naco Perrin Blvd.

rows.label: Frontage
rows.text: Approximately 450 feet on Perrin Beitel Road

rows.label: Utilities
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility and capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.text: The property is zoned C-2 in the City of San Antonio.
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: FEMA shows a very small amount of 100-year flood plain on the property. Seller completed a LOMR.

rows.label: Topography
rows.text: The site has a gentle slope. Drainage is to the southwest.

rows.label: Easements
rows.text: Utility easements are on the property.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: Texas Department of Transportation 2024 maps indicate 18,988 vehicles per day on Perrin Beitel, just south of the property.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025 and 2030.

rows.label: Area Development
rows.text: The property is completely surrounded by commercial and residential development which includes HEB, Wal-Mart, McDonalds, and many more.

comments: Prime commercial location on a major thoroughfare in northeast San Antonio
